covers: the 13-file SUPERSEDED former-head evidence set only. It says nothing about bootstrap-head-637/, which carries its own seal, nor about SUPERSEDED-FORMER-HEAD.md, REDACTION-AND-RESEAL-LEDGER.md, perf-budget-manifest.md, 40-observability/, 41-openapi/ or 42-production-ops/.
algorithm: sha256 over the exact bytes on disk. NO transform of any kind is applied before hashing. This replaces the previous seal's note, which described a redaction-before-hashing step that was never actually performed. Text digests are taken over the file content with CRLF normalised to LF: this tree holds seals recorded on both line-ending forms, so a raw byte digest can never verify on one platform. Content is unchanged; every re-pointed digest was proved to match the previously sealed bytes under the other line ending before it was rewritten (2026-09-06).

verificationOfPreviousSealBeforeReseal.note: The 11 .log files still matched the previous seal at the moment of re-sealing, so the chain of custody on every log body is unbroken from the original sealing up to the redaction.
